name: exposed-punish
description: §8.4 — a strike into a target Exposed by a failed Parry takes contest x1.25. Reuses the exact scenario verified in Task 5's combat.test.js Parry-failure unit test (parry fails since no strike is in flight when it resolves at t=50; punish starts strictly after, at t=51, to avoid retroactively counting as the strike the parry defended against).
